storyInfo: Leontuzzo, Lavinia, Demetri, and even Signora Sicilia—everyone knows Nuova Volsinii now stands at a crossroads.

attributes.content: Grazie infinite, Signor Bellone!
I would've been at such a loss, had it not been for you and your famiglia.
Come now, Zio Elio. I didn't do anything.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: Indeed, your name and presence were enough.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: My landlord dropping by as you were visiting me was enough to make him reconsider collecting his rent on the spot.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: After you left, he quickly agreed to give me two more weeks. That I'll figure out myself...
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: I don't understand, Zio Elio. Why are you...? What happened to your fruit stand?
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: Oh, that? Hah. Sold it long ago.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: My little Emma had a fever this summer, and who would have thought it would leave her paralyzed?
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: Luckily, Demetri introduced me to a good doctor, said it was a serious yet common summer ailment for children, and she might lose her legs if it wasn't treated.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: So I sold my fruit stand, and pooled cash from relatives to pay part of the doctor's fees. The rest is to be paid in installments.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: She's out of the woods now, at least. She has a slight limp, but she's otherwise healthy. As for the rent and bills... I'll figure it out.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: Your stand was on the corner... Metri and I bought oranges from you when we were little.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: We've been neighbors for years. I could've lent you some money, and you wouldn't have had to—
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: No, no, Signor Bellone. It's a vast sum, I wouldn't dare accept such a favor from you.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: Besides, your money wouldn't keep me afloat forever. I owe rent every week.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: But now that I'm under Famiglia Bellone's protection... my landlord won't kick me out when I fail to pay; and even the bakery will sell me some food on credit.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: But... you never wanted to join the Famiglia.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: You always said there was no need for civilians to join or involve themselves in famiglie affairs—that the most important thing was to work hard and live your best life.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: Ha! This old man was just naive.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: A famiglia is more than fighting and killing. I finally understand that.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: Don't worry, Signor Bellone. I may be old, but I know not to be ungrateful.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: The Bellones have helped me, so if you ever need a favor in turn, just call me and I'll be there!
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: ...You did this on purpose, didn't you? Metri.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: I asked you the other day why I haven't seen his fruit stand, and you told me he went home for a relative's funeral.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: You knew Emma was gravely ill.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: And when you suddenly invited me here for pizza the other day... you knew Zio Elio would pass by and find me.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: You handled it expertly, Leon.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: Handled what? I played right into your hands, if I had known sooner—
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: —You couldn't have done anything about it anyway. You couldn't have possibly known what sort of hardship he would face. Your assistance would've been limited.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: But at least I could've prevented him from joining the Famiglia against his wishes!
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: Only the Famiglia can help him now.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: Is that so? I beg to differ. What did this facade cost him, and how long will it even last?
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: He should've had access to more work opportunities, while we—Siracusa—should guarantee them a livelihood through systemic measures. Relying on the famiglie won't address the root of the problem.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: I hope the lesson you've learned from this is not charity or consideration for others, Leon.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: You're the Underboss. Someday, you'll be the head of the Famiglia yourself.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: A competent don knows offering timely help will earn you gratitude. They will owe you a favor, and repay their debt someday.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: You sound so heartless, Metri. Why did you even bother introducing a doctor to Zio Elio, then?
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: Shouldn't you have let me do it, if you wanted me to learn to extract gratitude?
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: You didn't know how ill Emma really was, and you didn't know he would have no choice but to sell the fruit stand.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: You just wanted to help him, and it had nothing to do with the Famiglia.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: We... can only do as much as we can, no?
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: Besides, old Elio's oranges were always the best. He clearly knows how to pick his suppliers.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: This is a trivial matter, compared to your available powers as the Mayor. Please, bring that murderous mafioso who ruined my Red Wine Championship to justice!
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: Signor Czarek, Demetri... Bellone's trial is this afternoon, but for now he remains only a suspect.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: But who else could it have been? He sees me as a competitor and is not above dirty tricks.
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: I kept my wines safely stored in the cellar, and even arranged for professional security to guard them, only to somehow have them swapped with Saluzzo's!
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: The prime suspect was arrested at the party, yet only placed under house arrest.
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: And there have been plenty of people knocking on his door to visit, console, and even plot more nastiness!
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: The whole city thinks him innocent, while Saluzzo Vino is raking in record profits.
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: While I, poor old Radoslaw, have gained absolutely nothing after spending so much time and effort organizing an event here in the hopes of doing some business in this thriving new city!
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: As far as I know, The Red Wine has been publishing articles about this murder case, and this has brought a lot of attention to your event.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: I understand you've already begun recruiting participants for your next Red Wine Championship, and there are even wine merchants from Columbia and Leithanien who have signaled an interest in participating.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: Indeed, but I should be enjoying greater gains than just those. Now, I'm left trying to minimize my massive losses.
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: Signor Czarek, we pledge to run the city fairly, according to the New Urban Management Act, but our government will not serve the interests of a lone businessman.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: Not you, or anyone else.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: That so? I hear you grew up with that Bellone boy, and now he's even taken your family name.
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: I am no longer affiliated with Famiglia Bellone in any way.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: But he's a member, no? Part of the purest Siracusan famiglia.
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: Even in his businessman costume, he's still most comfortable doing things mafia style.
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: ...You need to present proper evidence before we can hold a formal trial.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: Of course, we must follow due process. I am aware.
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: But my good Mayor, I pray you don't forget this—
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: Since the New Urban Management Act, many businessmen from Kazimierz, Leithanien, and Columbia have come here to trade.
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: And we, or at least the merchants under the K.G.C.C.'s banner, are only here in Nuova Volsinii and not in any other Siracusan city—because you have promised us the famiglie do not exist here.
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: The wine merchant leaves, but Leontuzzo remains still for a long time.
You seem exhausted. Did that wine merchant tie you up in his affairs again? Or is it Demetri?
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: *Sigh*.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: He's convinced we won't have a fair trial, and keeps bringing up his chamber of commerce to pressure me.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: Saluzzo Vino has indeed established itself in Nuova Volsinii under Demetri's management.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: But it remains a local enterprise, and it's hard to judge if it can compare with the commercial capabilities of Czarek's Golden Prairie.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: I fear Czarek is hounding Demetri not just because they're business competitors, or for that Championship incident.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: Metri... is merely an opportunity for Czarek and the chamber of commerce backing him.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: Most local merchants here do have ties to the famiglie, big or small.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: And if this background becomes valid grounds for accusations of wrongdoing, the local industry will come under pressure...
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: But we do need those foreign capitalists to trade here.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: We have to learn their modern ways of trade, we need their capital and goods.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: Even the way they compete with each other is something we need. It'll make our local businesses iterate and evolve to keep up.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: I'm aware of all that.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: But, Lavinia... our current situation is so far from what we originally envisioned...
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: Yes, we planned for a city without the famiglie, run with fairness and justice, not favoring any particular party.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: But now Nuova Volsinii has become an open gate to Siracusa, completely defenseless, free for any outsiders to enter, no matter their motives.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: The first group is of course, the Kazimierzians who exploit the loopholes in the New Urban Management Act.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: The exclusive shelf display agreement that Czarek and his fellow merchants include in their contracts has severely affected local industry.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: The various logistics contracts with high fines have also driven our local truckers into a corner...
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: Yes, Eirene has informed me of their situation. It seems like the K.G.C.C. is trying to undermine our AST.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: Also, other departments have given feedback on how they've been showing signs of wanting to involve themselves in the energy and healthcare sectors as well.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: According to last month's reports from city hall, many businesses in the service industry have shuttered, while the manufacturing industry is also struggling.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: Foreign-backed companies and shops have set up here, and they prefer to employ those from their own countries, so it is likely the job pool for locals will only shrink.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: Despite our best efforts, prices are still trending upwards...
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: Our people are not doing so well.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: And it is the Kazimierzians and Columbians we must face, but also—
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: The Leithanians who have come from all across Siracusa, and even from their own country with all manner of motives.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: Yes. And before them...
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: The fairness and justice we seek remain necessary—I still believe in this.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: But if such a pursuit must be traded for the livelihood of our citizens, then those so-called virtues will only end up being superficial formalities.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: You're right.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: I've... been mulling over it. Remember when I mentioned we might have to amend the New Urban Management Act—
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: We've made a revision. Want a look?
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: Leontuzzo takes the draft from Lavinia.
Two thin sheets of paper that should take no time to go through. But Leontuzzo flips through them multiple times before he finally looks up.
Impose tariffs on foreign goods...
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: Prevent foreign businesses from establishing a monopoly on key sectors like transportation, finance, and energy, and allow some factions with former famiglia ties access to lower management roles...
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: Issue franchise permits to famiglia-controlled corporations...
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: Is... this not a bit overboard? I fear people may say we're regressing to the old Siracusan way, or that we're favoring the famiglie.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: I did propose change, but these amendments are difficult to accept.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: I understand your concerns, Leon.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: I know you, of all people, hope to keep the famiglie out of this city.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: But you still seek to counter foreign capitalists with famiglie power.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: Leon, we all know Nuova Volsinii's government and our authority over the city were granted at Signora Sicilia's pleasure.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: But in Siracusa, as it stands now, the only force capable of uniting everyone is still the famiglie.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: But what we can do is limit and prevent the famiglie from growing their power, ensure they do not succumb to infighting, and most importantly, keep them from infringing on civilian interests.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: It's not an easy decision to make. Truth be told, I think it's not the right time to submit this draft either.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: Most citizens enjoy the employment opportunities brought in by foreign companies, as well as their cheap and trendy imported goods.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: Even if the K.G.C.C.'s ways inconvenience them, compared to the trouble caused by the mob wars of the past...
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: They will not think it much of a problem.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: Silence spreads throughout the office.
Leontuzzo knows Lavinia is right. Because he used to harbor such plans in his mind.
But it is not so easy to make the decision.
I get what you're trying to say.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: But just as Czarek and the K.G.C.C. want this chance to put Metri on trial, we also need an opportunity to convince ourselves and this entire city.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: Yes, and this chance may well come soon.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: The courtroom is packed. The afternoon trial has clearly drawn a lot of attention.
Sitting in the gallery are not only locals, but also the merchant Czarek's Kazimierzian partners, a Leithanian orchestra, and even Columbian traders.
All of their attention is fixated on one Demetri Bellone in the defendant's dock.

In accordance with the New Urban Management Act, the Nuova Volsinii criminal court will commence with the trial of the defendant, Demetri Bellone, on charges of the murder of Paola Memminger, case number 01452. Court is now in session.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: I call Tommaso Esposito to the witness stand.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: Signor Esposito, is it true you are a manager for Saluzzo Vino, in charge of the company's logistics?
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: Yes.
attributes.name: Tommaso

attributes.content: Two weeks ago, one day before the Golden Prairie's Red Wine Championship, you called an individual by the name of Sam at the Agenzia per la Sicurezza dei Trasporti.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: You asked him to deliver two bottles of Saluzzo wine to the event venue.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: Yes. I was very busy, and completely forgot about sending some wines to the competition, although I fortunately remembered to do so, the day before.
attributes.name: Tommaso

attributes.content: *sigh* Suffering from success, as it were.
attributes.name: Tommaso

attributes.content: When this Sam was delivering the goods via motorcycle, he came upon a crashed truck driven by an AST colleague, one Gianni. Gianni was on a Golden Prairie job at the time.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: Coincidentally, Gian just happened to be delivering goods specially prepared by Golden Prairie for the competition finals, and you just happened to be there as well.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: The coincidence isn't that unusual. Just goes to show how everyone loves doing things last-minute.
attributes.name: Tommaso

attributes.content: As for me, I was making my way over to the event venue to ensure my boss's instructions were being carried out properly, so I tagged along.
attributes.name: Tommaso

attributes.content: At the scene of the accident, you helped Sam get Gian into the ambulance, and you helped handle the aftermath—
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: Notably, you took those Saluzzo wines and placed them into the Golden Prairie box meant for the competition.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: The Golden Prairie guys said they'd find another driver, so I thought I'd save myself some trouble, since we were both delivering goods to the same destination.
attributes.name: Tommaso

attributes.content: But you took the Golden Prairie wines out of their box.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: And so the wines that appeared to the judges under the Golden Prairie name were, in fact, from Saluzzo Vino.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: That's their own carelessness!
attributes.name: Tommaso

attributes.content: They only had to look at the labels on the bottles to avoid that mistake. Am I wrong, Your Honor?
attributes.name: Tommaso

attributes.content: ...No further questions.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: I call Letizia Maroni to the witness stand.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: Signora Maroni, you work at the Nuova Volsiniese Police Academy as a toxicology expert and forensic pathologist.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: You were responsible for the autopsy of the victim, Paola Memminger, as well as the testing of the utensils and wine in the case.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: Yes.
attributes.name: Letizia

attributes.content: Please inform the court of your findings.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: Yes, Your Honor.
attributes.name: Letizia

attributes.content: The autopsy results show Paola Memminger died of cyanide poisoning.
attributes.name: Letizia

attributes.content: Traces of cyanide were found on the wine glass she used, but not inside the Saluzzo wine bottle.
attributes.name: Letizia

attributes.content: In other words, the murderer applied cyanide only to the glass, rather than the Saluzzo wine itself.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: I can only say the current evidence supports that conclusion.
attributes.name: Letizia

attributes.content: Calling Liesel Memminger to the witness stand.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: The little Caprinae steps out from the crowd of musicians around her, and slowly but resolutely walks toward the witness stand.
Signorina Memminger, is it true you are a member of the Schwarzervorhang Orchestra, and the adopted daughter of the deceased Paola Memminger?
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: Yes.
attributes.name: Liesel

attributes.content: On the day of the Red Wine Championship, you went to the cellar where all the competition wines were stored for an inspection.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: Yes.
attributes.name: Liesel

attributes.content: While you were there, you brushed past someone who was neither a security guard nor a member of any participating winery.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: ...Yes.
attributes.name: Liesel

attributes.content: Did you see what this individual did in the cellar?
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: I... saw him picking up a glass. But at the time, I only thought it a random, strange occurrence.
attributes.name: Liesel

attributes.content: No problems arose after he entered the cellar, so I assumed he was just a lost spectator.
attributes.name: Liesel

attributes.content: If I had known... If I had known what he was doing, I would have stopped him, and Paola wouldn't have...
attributes.name: Liesel

attributes.content: Liesel's voice trembles slightly as her volume lowers gradually. She looks down, hunched over, but ultimately she straightens her back.
My condolences.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: Did you get a clear look at his face?
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: ...I only saw him for a moment. I saw his face, but couldn't make it out clearly.
attributes.name: Liesel

attributes.content: Do you think you might recognize him?
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: No. He dressed very plainly. Thinking back, I believe he was maybe trying to trick the security guards, impersonating one of our orchestra members.
attributes.name: Liesel

attributes.content: I don't know who he was, but there is one thing I do know... he was definitely no Perro or Lupo you'd typically find in Siracusa.
attributes.name: Liesel

attributes.content: He had enormous Caprinae horns.
attributes.name: Liesel

attributes.content: Murmurs rise in the courtroom, like ripples from throwing a stone into water.
Lavinia continues her questions, and Liesel recounts in detail what her orchestra members were doing at the time, establishing their alibis.
But no one cares for her words at this point.
So Bellone didn't do it. I've been thinking it made no sense.
attributes.name: Irate Juror

attributes.content: He already won the championship, after all. What would he get by killing the conductor?
attributes.name: Irate Juror

attributes.content: But what if there's something else we still don't know?
attributes.name: Suspicious Juror

attributes.content: Also, couldn't he have just simply hired a Caprinae to do the deed?
attributes.name: Suspicious Juror

attributes.content: His men have sabotaged our wineries. He's been obviously after us, disrupting our perfectly legitimate business operations!
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: Silence! Order in the court!
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: I call Elio Fabri to the witness stand.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: Leontuzzo is shocked to see his old acquaintance in court.
He does not know why old Elio would be here.
He was not even aware that Elio had come to Nuova Volsinii.
Signor Fabri, is it true you are an employee of Saluzzo Vino, and responsible for procuring grapes for the company's production line?
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: Yes, Your Honor.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: Three weeks ago, you reached out to Verdi Winery to discuss procuring raw materials for Saluzzo Vino.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: Even though Verdi Winery's business has been declining ever since the Kazimierzian wineries set up shop, they always have the most aromatic grapes.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: Our company has a long-term cooperative agreement with Verdi to purchase any surplus materials their production lines cannot handle.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: The discussion was just part of my regular job.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: But during this meeting, you learned that Golden Prairie was about to buy out Verdi Winery.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: ...Yes.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: And so you conspired with Niccolo, a Verdi employee, to sabotage the winery's production facilities.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: Furthermore, you also sabotaged their water supply and drainage systems, causing Golden Prairie to incur substantial maintenance costs after their acquisition.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: ...Yes.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: You must be aware that these actions constitute unfair competition, and violate the New Urban Management Act.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: What was your motive? Did the owner of Saluzzo Vino, Demetri Bellone, compel you to do this?
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: Did he intend to disrupt Golden Prairie's business operations?
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: Elio does not answer immediately.
The Kazimierzian businessman in the gallery is silent, his expression now relaxed.
Meanwhile, Leontuzzo fails to make out Demetri's reaction from his calm demeanor in the defendant's dock.
No one compelled me to do anything, Your Honor.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: Everything I did was on my own conscience, out of my concern as a Nuova Volsiniese, as a Siracusan.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: It's true Golden Prairie is a competitor of ours. And our rivalry means I know well the methods they use.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: They dump their goods here for cheap, pressuring our local wineries into a smaller corner of the market, and then acquire them when they turn unsustainable.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: But they don't run the businesses properly after buying them out, much less try to preserve their unique winemaking traditions.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: They fire all the old staff to increase profit and efficiency, pretend to operate normally for a while, then shut it all down, leaving the vines to waste away.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: Verdi's the fourth. Before them, it was Triptych, Passadi Hills, and Drizzle...
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: All those wineries suffered the same treatment.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: That's how Kazimierz works.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: They don't care about the effort we put into tending our grapes, nor for our lives and the memories carried by the unique astringency in our traditional wines.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: All they want is to clear out their weaker competitors, one by one, until they monopolize all the shelves of every store.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: And we'll ultimately lose any choice in the products we buy. When that happens, I doubt their prices will stay as low as they are now.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: Well said. But that does not justify your use of illegal means.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: I know.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: I know what I've done won't stop the Kazimierzians from trampling all over our wine and other industries.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: But I had to do something. I'll accept whatever punishment I deserve.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: Murmurs from the gallery only grow louder and louder.
Lavinia raises the gavel in her hand, but hesitates for a while before she puts it down without striking the block.
Your Honor, if you would allow me a few words.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: ...Speak.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: I believe the testimonies you've heard from the witnesses you summoned are sufficient to prove I have no connection to the murder of Paola Memminger.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: But Elio Fabri is indeed in my company's employ.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: I did not compel him myself, and he did engage in activities deemed illegal by the New Urban Management Act, targeting Golden Prairie.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: I believe his reasons for doing so are perfectly understandable, not just to me, but to every Nuova Volsiniese sitting in the gallery right now.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: But a violation of the rules is a violation. I do not expect the court to make an exception for him.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: Though, as his boss, I am willing to bear the punishment for his crime, be it a fine or a prison sentence.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: The murmurs are now so loud that even the gavel fails to silence the crowd. Reporters in the back rows leave to contact their newspapers.
Lavinia announces the end of the trial; declaring the verdict to be given at a later date following jury deliberations.
Amidst the chaos, Leontuzzo catches Demetri looking at him.
He watches as Demetri raises his hand, puts his index and middle fingers together, and gently points them towards Leontuzzo, then himself.
He recognizes the action—a unique gesture they have both used since they were little to signal 'catch you later for a chat'.
Leontuzzo does not respond.
Yes, we've confirmed with the team responsible for guarding the Bellone estate that Elio Fabri did not visit Demetri Bellone's residence following the murder of Paola Memminger.
attributes.name: Security Guard

attributes.content: We have not monitored any calls between them either.
attributes.name: Security Guard

attributes.content: ...In other words, he just spoke of his own accord at the courthouse.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: That seems to be the case, as far as we can tell.
attributes.name: Security Guard

attributes.content: The jury has yet to reach a verdict, so we can only continue to watch the Bellone estate and keep Signor Fabri in custody for now.
attributes.name: Security Guard

attributes.content: I'd like to speak with him in private.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: By all means.
attributes.name: Security Guard

attributes.content: ...Zio Elio.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: I didn't know you were in Nuova Volsinii.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: Oh? I thought Signor Mayor and Judge Lavinia would've come across my name while scrutinizing entry applications from Bellone associates.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: I... didn't notice... but why are you still with them? I thought...
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: After Padre's death, Famiglia Bellone lost all the power it had. You should've left then—I know you never liked having to do things the mafioso way.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: Leave? I lost my fruit stand, Emma's fever left her with a lifelong need for medication, and I've been struggling...
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: If Don Demetri hadn't invited me to join his winery and source grapes for him, I don't know how I would've survived!
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: Nuova Volsinii provides job opportunities for everyone with the will to shape a future with their own hands...
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: Is that so? Do you think small businesses can still survive, under the Kazimierzian merchants' heel?
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: But your acts of sabotage... the famiglie used to do the same.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: The famiglie's ways of doing things... yes, they remind us, every citizen here, of our painful past.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: I do admit it was a shameful act—but fortunately, Judge Lavinia allowed me an opportunity to speak the truth in court.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: ...Lavinia... was the one who arranged for you to be there?
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: Yes.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: Sometimes, we have no choice but to only do as much as we can, no?
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: You asked me why I was still working for Don Demetri.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: It is because he still adheres to the old famiglia creed—
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: A pack of whelps grouping up to help each other can keep all of us from being devoured by a bigger beast.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: I heard your inauguration speech too. I could feel your passion.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: You asked how our neighboring nations would view us? Would they see us as a new possibility?
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: But now, I believe they do. They see us as a new avenue, to exploit us for their own gain!
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: Yes, I work for the Don.
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: But is it the Bellone businesses I care for and want to protect?
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: No, it is our own industry! It is Don Demetri who gave us this opportunity to unite and stand against the great merchants!
attributes.name: Elio

attributes.content: Congratulations on your not guilty verdict, Signor Bellone!
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: Oh? I thought you, of all people, would be most eager to see me behind bars.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: Just a misunderstanding!
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: The trial at court clearly proved your innocence, and the entire city knows of your magnanimity.
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: Let's put all the twists and turns that happened during the championship behind us. It is undeniable that your winery took the crown.
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: Saluzzo Vino now holds the title of number one winery in all Nuova Volsinii! Truly an enviable feat!
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: Thanks to you as well.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: ...Bah.
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: Surely you'll join the next iteration as well? Defending the crown would be a legendary achievement!
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: Perhaps.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: But as you say, Saluzzo Vino is now the number one winery in the city—
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: So I'm afraid I no longer see the value in joining a so-called competition to increase the value of my products. Am I right?
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: ...Fair enough. But Elio Fabri damaging a winery's water systems under the ownership of Golden Prairie surely impacts you somehow.
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: You said you'd pay his fine, or even serve his time. A noble gesture, but you don't necessarily have to follow through.
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: A trivial matter like that isn't worth a public prosecution in the first place. No one would've noticed the incident, had I not filed a lawsuit in the first place.
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: Signor Czarek, you can get straight to your point.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: What is your goal here? I don't think it's just to repair our working relationship with a tiny favor.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: Heh, I do appreciate frankness.
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: Regardless of our backgrounds, we are both businessmen now, are we not? So, Signor Bellone, I'd like to discuss a deal with you—
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: Let Golden Prairie invest in Saluzzo Vino. Our strong alliance will surely sweep the Siracusan markets.
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: And if, or when the time comes, our business empire will eventually expand beyond Siracusa and Kazimierz!
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: Oh, is that so?
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: Indeed! I know you currently do not lack for capital or production tech, and you have your reputation here.
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: But you must be aware of the Kazimierz General Chamber of Commerce behind me.
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: If we work together, our resources, like our comprehensive supply and logistic channels, and even the media channels we have ties with...
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: All of that will be available to you.
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: Surely a young, upstanding man like yourself doesn't want to stop at a single winery that doesn't even bear your name?
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: Have you never considered establishing a 'Bellone'—no, a 'Demetri' commercial empire?
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: Intriguing.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: I didn't expect the trial's outcome to impact your company and judgement so much.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: It did indeed leave its mark on my wine business, but Golden Prairie still retains its price advantage—
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: I'm thinking the K.G.C.C. was the impetus behind this effort to discuss a cooperative relationship.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: We are businessmen, Signor Bellone. We are naturally driven by the pursuit of maximum profit.
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: It is normal for us to set aside our preferences when discussing a deal in our quest for the most beneficial result.
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: As your employee said, this is how Kazimierz works.
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: So, think about it, young man. Don't be in such a rush to refuse me.
attributes.name: Czarek

attributes.content: Refuse? Did you think I would do that?
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: Leontuzzo arrives at Demetri's residence late at night.
The rain that lasted all day is now reduced to a faint drizzle, gradually slowing to a stop.
But his mood remains melancholic.
Security guards from city hall who are still at the estate lead him inside.
He thought Demetri would have come out to meet him, but he is mistaken.
Demetri is simply seated in a chair—a seat decided by old famiglia custom to be the don's—silently watching him.
A dim light over his head obscures his expression.
Leontuzzo suddenly realizes it has been a long time since he's read any expression from Demetri's face.
Here you are, after all.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: ...Yes. You asked me to come. I remember the gesture.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: A glass for each of us? I can mix a ginger fizz with apple juice you like as a base.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: Though it's hard to find traditionally pressed apple juice in Nuova Volsinii these days. I'm sure it's been a while since you've had any?
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: Fortunately, I found someone to help me acquire it.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: I'm sure you didn't call me here to reminisce about the old days.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: You can lower your guard.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: When I arrived here, I think I spotted a Kazimierzian's car leaving.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: The boss of Golden Prairie.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: Czarek? What was he doing here?
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: He wants to work with Saluzzo Vino.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: I agreed.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: Why?!
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: Why? Is this not what you people at city hall want?
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: Bringing in foreign capital will help local businesses to thrive and evolve. This is how businesses here and even across Siracusa will gain access to a wider market.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: Czarek was here as an agent of the K.G.C.C., and they offered generous terms. I had no reason to refuse.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: ...Kazimierzian businessmen aren't as nice as you might think.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: You're worried for me.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: You managed to gain the Saluzzos' assets with your particular methods, but this doesn't mean you will see the same results with the Kazimierzians.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: We can only try and see.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: Also, city hall will surely protect the interests of us local businesses, yes?
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: I know an amendment to the New Urban Management Act sits on your desk. Just missing your signature.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: How do you...?
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: Just some of those so-called underhanded famiglia methods.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: We should always seek all the intelligence we can to make the most beneficial decisions.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: I believe I taught you this long ago when I was grooming you to be the don.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: That amendment... is just a draft.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: I might not even sign it.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: You're hesitating, I know. You just can't make up your mind.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: You fear the people will denounce you, that all your achievements will go to waste, that Nuova Volsinii will return to the old famiglia ways.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: Should I not be afraid? It's too easy, going back to our familiar methods, while new sparks are so hard to start.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: All the famiglie outside the city are watching our every move.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: Give them one chance, and we'll be torn to shreds, never to recover.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: But you have more to worry about than just the famiglie.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: Besides the Kazimierzan and Columbian businessmen who exploit loopholes in the Act, there are also Leithanians trying to expand their influence in the city—
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: Did you know? I received some surprising news just before the competition.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: Someone was dispatched here from the Leithanian border for the sole purpose of dispatching the exiled dissident Paola Memminger.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: Leithanien's Eternal Grace forbids anyone from deviating from their Movement, even outside Leithanian territory.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: And you used this to your advantage.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: I didn't fan the flames, I simply let it be.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: Fortunately, things turned out well, and you also have a chance to amend the Act.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: Is this not what city hall has been waiting for, this whole time?
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: I believe Lavinia arranged that trial just for that.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: I do intend to limit foreign capital here, but that does not mean—
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: Who else can you even rely on, if not us local businessmen?
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: Regardless of whether or not we have famiglia backgrounds, we are all at least complying with your city's rules.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: We can act as your insurance.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: Empty promises mean nothing to me.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: I know you are skeptical of the famiglie.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: But you should understand we started off as nothing but a band of whelps, powerless against the barrens and chaos of Siracusa.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: We helped those around us, and hoped the day might come when we could win something in return, to improve our lives.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: We Siracusans take care of our own. It is our tradition, and what I've always done.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: So after the Don's death, after you left, I took the Bellones' reins.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: Because I cannot let the famiglia lose their home.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: Just as you cannot let the Siracusans lose ground to foreigners from Kazimierz, Leithanien, and Columbia.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: Or am I wrong?
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: You will do great things, Leon.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: One day you will actually be able to realize your dreams in Siracusa. I've always believed this.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: I've heard this from you before... Metri.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: I said back then you could be my right-hand man. The offer remains, even now, at city hall...
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: No, grazie. I really don't get along with Lavinia.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: And, as you said before, there are things better suited for her, and others only I can handle.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: Just like right now, some matters are for city hall to carry out, while others are better for us to do.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: Your ideals alone cannot keep Nuova Volsinii alive. This city needs and must have the support of the old famiglie.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: You sound so certain...
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: You met Signora Sicilia.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: I'm sure you know well just how happy she is to meet young people with ideas.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: Your established rules will keep the famiglie in Nuova Volsinii from running amok, while my ways will gather all the power and spirit of Siracusa.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: This will become a new Guns and Order for this city, Leontuzzo.
attributes.name: Demetri

attributes.content: As Leontuzzo leaves, Demetri extends a hand towards him.
A signal of cooperation. Leontuzzo hesitates for a moment before stretching out a hand himself.
They used to be close, no strangers to sharing hugs or laughter, but this formal handshake now is the first between them.
At the conclusion of their handshake, Demetri returns to his chair.
Then, just like Leontuzzo's father and every Siracusan don, he disappears into the darkness.
The rain is no more. The sky is surprisingly clear and tranquil.
That amendment... are you really okay with it, Lavinia?
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: We used to want for a Siracusa without even a trace of the famiglie.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo

attributes.content: I spent more than a decade under the Bellones' shadow, Leon.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: I don't mind waiting a little longer.
attributes.name: Lavinia

attributes.content: Then the same goes for me.
attributes.name: Leontuzzo
